name: Camp Lewis Perkins Day Camp
operator_name: Girl Scouts of Central & Western Massachusetts
description_short: Girl Scout day camp in South Hadley open to all girls, with fields, woods and trails. Campers play team games, make nature art, shoot archery, swim in an in ground pool and build campfires, around a weekly theme.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel in writing four weeks or more before the session for a refund minus the $75 deposit; no refunds within four weeks or for missed days, with partial or full refunds possible for documented medical emergencies.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim in an in ground pool, with a modified Christian's Law swim test; non swimmers wear life jackets in water over two feet deep.
